item.text:
The reference appears to be a thin hinge leaf with three barrel sections, two narrow gaps, and an axial bore.

The editable model is available in the [CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8773/#part.FCStd).
The preview now matches the leaf’s orientation and the barrel’s visible side in all four views. I’ll adjust the leaf width, then validate the solid and export the STEP file.
